title: Chapter 404
paragraphs: Chapter 404
Episode 119. The Feast of Gyeomhwang Castle (9)
The red jade from his pocket emitted light.
[Meow!]
As Jin climbed onto Shuri's back, Ron cleared a path for him.
Swoosh-!
Ron's massive sword energy swept away the monsters in front of them in an instant. Blood and flesh splattered like a fountain, and Shuri raced through the gap.
Seeing this, Murakan quickly descended and transformed back into human form. It seemed like a black wind was rushing toward Jin.
"Kid, where are you going?"
"I have to find Veradin."
"Why?"
"Kinzelo is behind the terrorist forces. Their goal is to create a hostile relationship between Hyran and Zipfel."
Murakan tilted his head briefly and then showed that he understood.
"Hmm, I got the gist of it."
"Did you see Veradin from above?"
"No, I don't think he was there."
"Go back up and check again. If you see him, let me know immediately. If not, you continue to patrol the skies."
"You're going to look for that guy alone? Who knows what kind of monster will pop up."
"There can't be any evidence left, so there probably won't be anyone as strong as Berakt. If I find myself in a situation where I can't handle it alone, I'll send a signal."
"Alright."
Murakan returned to his original form and soared into the sky.
There were no other signals from Murakan for a while. Veradin must have already left the battlefield.
'There were terrorists among the audience. Veradin must have moved to avoid them.'
Who were the ones sitting near Veradin?
The masked royals were closest. As the next leader of Zipfel, Veradin naturally had a seat near the royals in the Bivment.
It was most reasonable to assume that Veradin was being attacked by them and fleeing.

Jin, Lata, and Ron were at the front of the battlefield where the outer wall had collapsed. Excluding the inner passages, that was the only exit, so it was impossible for Veradin to have escaped there.
'Kinzelo's men took advantage of the fact that the royals always wear masks.'
Shuri changed direction.
Not towards the outer walls, but to check the castle first, as he was sure he needed to.
However, he couldn't use the normal passages. The passages were still completely saturated as the guards were evacuating the general guests.
Without hesitation, Jin wrapped his sword in aura.
Squeak-!
With a single slash, the thick wall was cut like a sheet of paper.
The guards in the back were blocking the incoming monsters and protecting the guests, so they had no spare energy to open a path, let alone the pressure of damaging Gyeomhwang Castle.
Thud!
The square-cut wall fell with a heavy noise.
"Move through the passage!"
Leaving those words behind, Jin quickly left the central arena.
The inside of the castle was just as chaotic. Servants were running around frantically, and biological golems that had infiltrated from the outer walls could be seen one by one.
Just as a biological golem was about to pounce on a group of servants, Shuri leaped and swung her front legs.
As the monster's head burst, the servants screamed with pale faces.
"Thank you...!"
"Has anyone seen Veradin?"
"Who, who are you talking about?"
"Veradin Zipfel. He has long white hair and is wearing a white coat."
"I haven't seen him."
"But, Sir Jin. We haven't seen Sir Veradin, but there was also chaos at the pottery warehouse inside the castle."
They were the warehouse management servants.
"Explain in detail."

"We heard the news that the terrorist attack started at the central arena, and we were trying to spread the word to others. But suddenly, there was an explosion in the warehouse and we were avoiding it."
"We don't know the details, but it seemed to be caused by magic. The guards went in to check, but we haven't heard any news since."
It seemed like they had found a clue as soon as they entered the castle.
"Which way is the warehouse?"
"I'll personally follow you and show you."
"I'm not sure I can protect you while solving the problem. Draw me a map."
The servant quickly took out paper and pen from his pocket and drew a map.
"Here it is."
"Other guards will come out soon, so don't move and wait here."
He immediately followed the map to the pottery warehouse.
The pottery warehouse was one of the largest warehouses in Gyeomhwang Castle. It stored more than 90% of the pottery collected by Ron and previous castle masters over a hundred years.
The warehouse was completely destroyed from the entrance.
There were embers everywhere.
'It's not ordinary fire, it's the trace of fire magic. It's even 9th level or higher.'
Veradin's main magic was fire.
As he entered, the pottery shards crushed under Shuri's steps.
There were also traces of other magic that was not fire.
Earth, ice, lightning.
And darkness.
Dark magical clumps that looked like black beads were rolling around. He hadn't seen much dark magic, but there was no other way to explain the form if it wasn't that.
'Where did Kinzelo find such magicians after the Dark Magic Society was completely annihilated?'
There was no way that renowned archmages who attacked Hyran would participate in such an attack. Mages like Chukon Toldera, Susan Lillista, and Kidad Hall were already dead.
Either there were more unknown mages within Kinzelo or they had accomplices.
Finding Veradin was the priority for now. It was clear that there had already been intense battles, and time was of the essence.
All that could be seen were broken pottery and debris; it seemed Veradin and Kinzelo's terrorists had already moved to another location.
'There were no signs of battle except at the entrance. There must be another passage leading inside the pottery warehouse.'
The passage inside the pottery warehouse was also drawn on the map.
It was a long, dark passage. Even after riding Shuri for quite a while, the path continued.
Jin stopped Shuri because he found corpses. The three corpses were Veradin's escort warriors seen at the banquet hall.
Of course, they weren't all of them, but it wasn't hard to guess that Veradin was in a losing situation.
Upon leaving the passage, a drain was immediately visible. The passage in the pottery warehouse was one of the escape routes prepared for emergencies.
Behind Jin, the dark sky dyed with energy was visible. The distant explosions and shockwaves from the battlefield still signaled that the fierce battle was ongoing.
Which direction should he go?
There were no visible footprints. There were too many obstacles to find the path using earth and wind magic.
While pondering, he saw a red light in the distance.
A familiar light that appeared when fire gems exploded, it was definitely Veradin's magic.
As soon as he saw that magic, Jin had to be sure that Veradin was already 'injured.'
It was because the feeling of instability and weakness was strong for Veradin's magic, which had already reached 9th level.
"Let's go, Shuri!"
[Mrowr!]
Finally, Veradin was found on a plain.
Veradin was fighting with his remaining two escorts against gray-robed mages and the biological golems they controlled.
"Veradin!"
Veradin turned his head at Jin's voice.
Zap!
The biological golems surrounding Veradin were blown away by the lightning Jin cast.
Jin rushed in between and checked on Veradin's condition.
Blood flowed from his lips, and his body was full of wounds. Fortunately, there was no fatal injury, but the severe bleeding could have killed him if the battle continued.
"I knew you'd come."
Veradin said with a faint smile.
Those words felt strangely significant.
"What do you know, getting caught by those things like an idiot."
"They're quite strong, those guys. I can't believe there were mages like this among those I didn't know. At first, I really thought they were Gomo's subordinates."
At that moment, the question that crossed Jin's mind was this.
"Is Veradin really in a complete state right now?"
Even if he was not complete, there would be no change in the fact that they were going to save Veradin, but suddenly, a strange point came to mind.
Why didn't Veradin send a rescue signal while coming here?
Even if he only attended the banquet and did not have a flare, he could have sent a signal using magic.
Even if he was attacked by those disguised as royalty in the audience and lost his mind, he could have made a sound. There were certainly many other warriors around Veradin who could help him.
"Maybe if he was in a manipulated state, this situation would have been orchestrated deliberately. It would be advantageous for Ziephel in many ways if Hyeran fell into trouble."
The traces of magic left in various parts of the pottery warehouse seemed somewhat contrived as if they were left on purpose when thinking about it again.
In particular, the traces of dark magic left behind ostentatiously bothered him.
It was as if Veradin had evidence of struggling alone with those who used dark magic. Inside Geomhwang Castle, where there were as many warriors as one could kick.
However, Veradin, who sighed in relief when he saw Jin, was unmistakably a familiar white-haired man.
"I can't be sure. Just like at the banquet."
Jin turned around and looked at the gray robes.
The gray robes had temporarily stopped their attack at Jin's appearance, and though hidden by the hood, they seemed to be flustered.
"Veradin Ziephel."
"Yeah, Jin."
"Why didn't you send a rescue signal?"
"I didn't have a chance. I was attacked from the audience and was out of my mind trying to flee."
It was an expected answer.
And Jin concluded that at least Veradin's mind was not 'completely' intact.
"Jin Runkandel, the 12th generation of Runecandel, has come to rescue you on the special order of Geomhwang Castle Lord Ron Hyeran. Remember this fact for sure. Do you understand?"
"...I understand. I owe my life to Lord Ron."
"Take care of your body with the escort warriors. I'll deal with them."
As Jin gathered energy, the small stones on the plain began to float in the air. The gray robes were also releasing their magic again.
"They're certainly inferior to the Spirits."
Still, there were four magicians who could imitate the Spirits.

"If they really planned to kill Veradin, the gray robes in Geomhwang Castle would have targeted Veradin too. Veradin must have sent only enough numbers to barely escape while fighting alone, on purpose."
If the level of four magicians was enough for Veradin to fight and escape.
It meant they were no match for Jin.
As long as Jin was careful with dark magic, which was an unknown territory for him.
"Don't think about going back alive."
As Sigmund emitted light, magical energy gathered in Jin's palm, swirling around.
The legacy of the Great Magician Kidard Hall.
It was the magical power needed to unfold the reverse sky.
